cloud.title: Connect to the Klyqa cloud
cloud.description: Sign in with your Klyqa account to fetch the access tokens of your devices. The devices themselves are controlled locally on your network.

data_description.environment: Use Production unless you have a Klyqa test account.

local.title: Add a local device
local.description: Enter the device address and its access token. Development firmware accepts the development token.

add_feeding_schedule.name: Add feeding schedule
add_feeding_schedule.description: Adds a feeding schedule to a Foody pet feeder. The feeder holds up to 20 schedules; the new one takes the lowest free slot.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Foody pet feeder to add the schedule to.

time.name: Time
time.description: Time of day the feeding starts. The feeder stores hours and minutes only.

portions.name: Portions
portions.description: Number of portions to dispense, 1 to 40.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration in seconds the feeder stores with this schedule, 0 to 10800. The feeder accepts the value and passes it on to its feeding unit; its effect is not verified.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Days the schedule runs on. Left empty, it runs every day.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the schedule is active straight away.

skip_once.name: Skip once
skip_once.description: Skip the next due feeding of this schedule, then carry on as usual.

fresh_food_mode.name: Fresh food mode
fresh_food_mode.description: A per-schedule mode flag the feeder passes on to its feeding unit. Its effect is not verified, so leave it off unless you know you need it.

auto_play_voice.name: Play voice recording
auto_play_voice.description: Play the recorded call before the food is dispensed.

set_feeding_schedule.name: Change feeding schedule
set_feeding_schedule.description: Changes an existing feeding schedule of a Foody pet feeder. Fields you leave out keep their current value.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Foody pet feeder that holds the schedule.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: ID of the schedule to change, as listed in the schedules attribute of the feeding schedules sensor.

time.name: Time
time.description: New time of day for the feeding. The feeder stores hours and minutes only.

portions.name: Portions
portions.description: New number of portions to dispense, 1 to 40.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: New duration in seconds to store with this schedule, 0 to 10800. The feeder accepts the value and passes it on to its feeding unit; its effect is not verified.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: New set of days the schedule runs on.

skip_once.name: Skip once
skip_once.description: Skip the next due feeding of this schedule, then carry on as usual.

fresh_food_mode.name: Fresh food mode
fresh_food_mode.description: A per-schedule mode flag the feeder passes on to its feeding unit. Its effect is not verified, so leave it off unless you know you need it.

auto_play_voice.name: Play voice recording
auto_play_voice.description: Play the recorded call before the food is dispensed.

delete_feeding_schedule.name: Delete feeding schedule
delete_feeding_schedule.description: Deletes a feeding schedule from a Foody pet feeder.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Foody pet feeder that holds the schedule.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: ID of the schedule to delete, as listed in the schedules attribute of the feeding schedules sensor.

device_not_found.message: No device with the id {device_id} exists

device_not_klyqa.message: {device} is not a Klyqa Pet device

device_not_available.message: {device} is not available; its Klyqa Pet entry is not loaded, or the device has not been reached yet

not_a_foody.message: {device} is not a Foody pet feeder; feeding schedules exist only on the Foody

unknown_schedule.message: {device} has no feeding schedule with the id {schedule_id}

no_free_schedule_slot.message: {device} already holds the maximum of {maximum} feeding schedules; delete one first

rate_limited.message: {device} is rate limiting requests; another client (for example the Klyqa app) is polling it at the same time

token_refresh_failed.message: {device} rejected its access token and the Klyqa cloud could not be reached to refresh it

device_auth_failed.message: {device} rejects the access token from the Klyqa account; re-pair the device in the Klyqa app
